_about: API-06 settings mapping (tools/api-rules.mjs addressParameters). `public`: each page-address parameter the viewer reads, mapped to the public `Export.member` that sets the same thing (checked against the real public surface). `addressOnly`: parameters with no public setting yet: reason, review finding (docs/architecture/api-review-2026-11-01.md), Objective expected to give them one. A parameter that gets a public key, or is no longer read, must come off `addressOnly`.
